launchBlockingDefects.summary: Stripe webhook payments fail for every org: recordPayment (lib/services/payments.ts:704) sends p_received_at undefined, the key is dropped, and apply_invoice_payment_with_details_atomic has no default, so PostgREST finds no function. Production (read-only check): 4 payment_intent.succeeded webhooks failed in Sept 2026; last recorded Stripe payment 2026-06-01. Fix the call and replay the failed events after a decision.

Builder connections linked-jobs list always throws: listProjectConnectionsForGrants (lib/services/project-connections.ts:354) embeds projects ambiguously (project_id and source_project_id FKs → PGRST201). Disambiguate the embed.

Mirror on a link-created job withholds the job's 10% retainage (createMirror → createInvoice, connected-receivables.ts:284), so it never equals the bill; the next sync voids it and cannot reissue (number clash counts void invoices, line 238 vs createInvoice), retrying forever and never recording payment.

Resuming a paused link does not catch up: tg_project_connections_follow_grant enqueues nothing on resume, so bills approved or submitted during the pause stay stale until the builder changes them again.

Billing book double-counts held retainage on progress-billing jobs: lib/services/billing-book.ts:214 adds ledger retainage and SOV retainage, which carry the same amount (1,280,000 shown for 640,000 held).

Retainage release cannot complete: pay-applications.ts:1167 calls release_prime_sov_retainage with the member client (not executable by authenticated), and post_pay_application refuses a release application ('Application changed during submission').

Automatic weekly overtime never runs: time-overtime.ts:93 and timesheets.ts:386 return early when cost_cents is not null, but cost_cents is a generated column and never null. Payroll CSV and Books reconciliation are wrong as a result (6,800 wage variance in the scenario).

Pay period summary always throws: getPayPeriodSummary (timesheets.ts:501) reads books_payroll_imports with the member client (service_role only); closePayPeriod (line 432) ignores the same error so the import never links.
Time clocked on a job with no cost-coded budget cannot be approved: the clock offers no code but approval requires one (cost-plus.ts:1879) and the crew queue shows it read-only.

A tracked builder invitation has no customer email and the opportunity room cannot add one, so its quote cannot be sent (trade-quotes.ts:490-512, quote-editor.tsx:209); the job made from it inherits a customer with no email.

scenarios.title: Provision and role sweep
scenarios.summary: Provision an electrical trade org on the trade plan; owner, office admin, foreman and crew sweep every route; trade desks load, builder desks redirect with a reason, settings and iOS catalog show no builder modules, and no forbidden vocabulary renders.

scenarios.title: SOV job for a GC with retainage
scenarios.summary: Residential-posture job for a GC customer billed by SOV with 10% retainage held: pay app 1 with conditional progress waiver, GC certifies on portal, invoice issued, partial ACH, retainage shown as held receivable, final pay app releases retainage with unconditional final waiver, change order approved in between.

scenarios.title: Homeowner T&M job
scenarios.summary: Two crew clock 6h each with cost codes, a $340 supply receipt, T&M ticket signed on /t, invoice generated and paid by card, labor and material posted to the job.

scenarios.title: Two-week pay period
scenarios.summary: Crew clock in and out across three jobs; one entry crosses the weekly OT threshold and is auto-flagged; foreman bulk-approves with time.approve only; admin locks the period; payroll CSV exported; provider register imported into Books payroll and reconciles to recognized labor.

scenarios.title: Invite to job
scenarios.summary: Builder invitation appears as an ITB with due date; quote built from labor, material and markup; sent via /e; follow-up logged; accepted; converted to a job carrying contract amount, customer and billing basis.

scenarios.title: Receipts without a job
scenarios.summary: Fuel receipt captured on mobile with no job lands in overhead and is matched to a Books bank transaction; a supply-house receipt is reassigned to a job.

scenarios.title: Builder on Arc, sub on Arc
scenarios.summary: QA builder org invites the QA trade org; accepting creates a linked trade job; the sub's pay app submitted in the builder portal appears on the trade's billing book as the same receivable, once; COI shared from the vault reaches the builder's compliance record.

scenarios.title: Mobile contract
scenarios.summary: pnpm test:mobile: organizations exposes the profile, workspace catalog omits builder modules for a trade org, clock in/out and job-optional receipt capture round-trip.

verificationRule.rule: An item is verified when every golden scenario it maps to (scenarioIds) passed on the isolated acceptance stack with current evidence, and its source review is current. Same rule as Arc Books and Arc Production.
